Uh, I can't remember the the exact settings from voltage and frequency. Um, but it was pushing close to twelve.
Got it — pushing close to 12, which is basically stock. So the overclocking was more about understanding the unit than chasing extra hashrate. Is that fair?
That's fair. But also out of stock out of the box, it was closer to nine terahash per second. So I'm not sure if you know, it was under clocked at the box or what it may have been.

Got it — wattage you can plug directly into "kWh × my rate = $ on the bill." Joules-per-terahash is one layer of abstraction too far.
